features.label: CoolYarn Technology
features.body: Yarn shape improves airflow, helping heat escape more efficiently and keeping surface temperatures lower.

features.label: Enhanced Durability
features.body: Engineered yarn structure enhances fiber strength, making the material both stronger and more durable.

features.label: UV-Stabilized
features.body: Resists fading, helping maintain color and appearance even with prolonged sun exposure.

items.body: Optimizes airflow to reduce surface temperature in extreme weather. UV-stabilized to resist fading from the sun.
Allergen-free, easy to clean, and comfortable to play on. A great choice for any pet owner.
No watering, mowing, or fertilizing needed. Even in a drought, your lawn stays lush and beautiful year-round.
100% non-toxic and guaranteed lead-free. No pesticides or fertilizers required — safe for your family.
